description:
Rename budget to threshold in Go code, to match docs/00-glossary.md. No design talk needed.

Glossary: Threshold = estimated cost per run above which a run is flagged. It does not stop anything. The dashboard already says "threshold"; the code says BudgetMicros and OverBudget (internal/core/model.go, validation.go, report.go, telemetry.go, internal/web/server.go, templates.html).

Rename to ThresholdMicros / OverThreshold (or similar). Keep JSON keys budget_micros and over_budget, and the form field name if changing it would break anything, for stored data and backwards compatibility.

Check: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...
title: Rename budget to threshold in code
